scheme_name: Maintenance Of Pregnant Desi/Indigenous Cow/Buffalo Ration Scheme For BPL Families Belonging To Scheduled Caste (SC) Category
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh
Livestock owners belonging to BPL families of Scheduled Caste (SC) category
Must rear Desi/Indigenous or cross‑bred cows or buffaloes
Benefit is limited to a maximum of two animals per family
Applicant must provide proof of BPL status, land documents, and bank account details
benefits_summary: Provides a 50 % subsidy on 3 kg daily balanced ration for up to two pregnant cows or buffaloes during the last trimester, enhancing milk yield and farmer income.
